intent: Cluster test verifying leader can stand down quickly with slow work outstanding: a command stuck in a 5s HTTPS request, and one scheduled 5s in the future, must not block stand-down/failover, yet still complete correctly afterward.

objects.name: FastStandDownTest::testHTTPSRequests
objects.role: starts a slow HTTPS command on leader, stops leader mid-request, confirms fast failover and correct escalation

objects.name: FastStandDownTest::testFutureCommands
objects.role: same shape for a command scheduled 5s in the future
